executive_summary: Freeze numerical translation validation and transfer interpretation before aggregate scores are opened.
change_scope: Geometry validation only. No draw, prediction, shift, training, scorer, continuous result or success-gate changes.
shape: Identical, nonempty arrays with axis0 representing draws; all entries finite.
centered_geometry: Subtract each array's cell median; maximum absolute difference <=32*eps*scale. rtol=0. Per-cell bound is at least as strict as the requested whole-array magnitude bound.
order: Stable baseline sort only for checking. Fail if a baseline adjacent gap >32*eps*scale becomes candidate gap <-32*eps*scale. Do not reorder or mutate forecast arrays.
moments: Variance of median-centered draws and their second moments must agree within 4*tau*max(1,centered_magnitude)+tau^2+8*gamma_n*max(1,both_variances,both_second_moments), gamma_n=n*eps/(1-n*eps).
constant_rationale: 32 provides a fixed conservative roundoff budget for addition, subtraction and median centering. Moment bound follows propagation of a centered perturbation plus a draw-count-derived reduction roundoff bound. No transfer scores are inputs to any tolerance.
primary_transfer_model: M1, fixed by the previously frozen continuous best-nonzero Ridge result. Report all M0-M5; never choose a model from transfer scores.
continuous_gate: Always preserve prior continuous primary NO, prior controls and prior model results byte-for-byte.
next_axis_priority: M1 multi marginal<1 AND joint>1.10 AND composite>=1 => PATH-01
M1 single<=.90 AND multi composite<=.90 AND multi marginal<1 AND multi joint<=1.10 => LOCATION-02 research follow-up only
M1 single<=.97 AND at least two families have composite<1 AND F1 or F2 composite<1 => CONTEXT-01 descriptive hypothesis
f1_verdict: marginal<1 AND joint>1.10 AND composite>=1 => LOCATION_SIGNAL_BUT_PATH_REQUIRED
marginal<1 AND joint<=1.10 AND composite<1 => CARD_LOCATION_TRANSFER_POSITIVE
transfer_diagnostic: POSITIVE only for coherent primary M1 single/multi composite<1 with both marginal ratios<1 and both applicable joint ratios<=1.10; NEGATIVE when both composite>=1 and both marginal>=1; otherwise MIXED. Any guard failure => TRUE_GEOMETRY_VIOLATION and no aggregation.
public_private_boundary: Individual card outcomes/components/ratios remain private. Public transfer_card_summary.csv has geometry flags, metadata and hashes only. Public JSON/CSV score summaries aggregate the full fixed groups.
component_capture: Additional descriptive component capture uses (1-component_candidate_ratio)/(1-component_oracle_ratio), with matching applicable cards and undefined capture when oracle ratio equals1. Composite scoring and aggregation remain the original LOCATION-01 routines.
